common_note: THE FINAL M3 REVIEW (Part A §A7, Part B §B4): the whole milestone is built and merged: every archetype (Street Punk, Kicker, Pipe Thug, Bruiser, the graybox Boss), the enemy base and director, the crowd room with mixed waves and the boss wave, enemy grabs on the player with mash-to-break, the rear warning, F1/F3/F4, and the instruments. M3's done-when: 'a 6-enemy fight is readable, and the warning fires correctly behind-left, behind-right and directly behind.' The slice gate passed for the Punk (docs/milestones/M3-slice-gate.md, docs/reviews/M3/slice-*.json); don't re-report what it settled unless it regressed. Calls already made by default are in docs/milestones/M3-judgement-calls.md and docs/milestones/M3-calls/*.md: don't re-litigate them unless they break the spec or the done-when. P4-int recorded the evidence acts with the probe on (tests/bot/acts/crowd_acts.gd: 'Mixed six, observed', 'Mixed six, fight', 'Waves to the boss', 'Rear warning, every archetype', 'Perf, six with ragdolls'); its sheets, logs and readability.json files are in /Users/arachne/repos/beat-em-up-PoC/.worktrees/m3-p4-int/captures/m3_p4/ (read docs/milestones/M3-calls/P4-int.md first). tools/check_m3_log.py checks a crowd log. The hard metrics R1, R2, R3, R10, R11 must pass; the soft ones are judged (a soft miss is a finding only if a player would notice it).

lenses.brief: Lens L1, WARNING CORRECTNESS for EVERY archetype (Part B §B1 clause by clause): the Punk, Kicker (its jump kick's 2.75 m reach includes the leap: does a Kicker winding up from 3.75 m behind warn, and does it read as crying wolf when it can't reach?), Thug, Bruiser and Boss (heavy: larger burst; the charge's 5.3 m reach from behind; the grab's wind-up and the follow-up while holding); behind-left, behind-right, directly behind, the 159/161 edge, in view, out of range; the end on land/block/whiff/interrupt/grab/KO/vanish, never on the strike coming out; armor: a jab absorbed by a Bruiser or the boss must NOT end its warning; two attackers on a side brighter; the KO-view hide; pause, slow-mo, 0.25x; audio direction. Use P4-int's 'Rear warning, every archetype' act, test_m3_done_when.gd and test_rear_warning*.gd, and check_m3_log.py over the crowd logs. Corner-crop sheets for every archetype.

Lens L2, FIRST-PERSON CROWD READABILITY with MIXED waves (Part B §B4's L2 rubric, all ten questions, frame references; soft metrics R4-R9, R12, R13, R15 from readability.json): 'Mixed six, observed', 'Mixed six, fight', 'Waves to the boss'. Judge: can you tell each archetype at a glance (palettes: Punk teal + yellow cap, Kicker lime + black cap, Thug olive + white cap + yellow pipe, Bruiser purple, Boss charcoal + orange; are the Kicker and Thug confusable?); do mixed crowds posture AROUND the player; flinch-lock; the lens covered at strike range (R8) with big bodies; the non-KO knockdown view ('belly slab', M2's default) now that knockdowns are frequent (sweep, smash, charge, headbutt): flag it if a player would be lost; get-up pops in a crowd; the Kicker's flank; would a new player know why they took damage.

Lens L3, ARCHETYPE TELLS AND IDENTITY: every enemy attack's wind-up seen from the player's lens at 3 m and at its strike range (Punk jab, cross link, shove; Kicker jump kick and sweep; Thug's three swings; Bruiser smash, grab, headbutt; Boss charge, pound, grab, slam): does each read as itself and differ from the others; does any taunt or strafe read as a threat; armor reads (grey spark, clank, ARMOR, no flinch) and the haymaker's armor break; the enemy grab: the held view, MASH prompt, break-free, headbutt and slam, no lens clipping (nothing within 0.25 m except a deliberate hit); the Thug's pipe drop, the LB cue and the pickup; the boss's phase 2 (turn, beckon, adds walking in) and its bar. Record what you need with the archetype acts in tests/bot/acts/*_acts.gd.

Lens L4, CODE AND LAYERS on the whole M3 diff (git diff c971cf4..HEAD -- game tests tools): simulation never reads a camera; presentation writes no game state (the LB cue, armor spark, MASH prompt, RearWarning, DebugDraw); no feel numbers in scripts; static types and ## docs; archetypes that override base-PRIVATE members (boss.gd, bruiser.gd, kicker.gd: list each, judge the coupling and whether a test guards it); tokens and holds released on every exit path (hit, grab, break-free, KO, vanish, F4 'remove all', F6 room switch, menu_open, ai_frozen); groups left before queue_free; the dropped pipes' cap; determinism and flakiness (run the full suite twice); a preset saved before M3 loads cleanly; tools/check_m3_log.py correct; 0 'resources still in use' and 0 ERROR lines in bot runs.

Lens L5, FAIRNESS AND PACING (Part B §B4 L5): R3 (no unwarned hit), R11 (no non-boss knockdown over 15), R12 (passive time to KO, worst 2 s; the Thug's 30-damage combo makes R12's 30 impossible by spec: judge whether that is fair), R13 (waves cleared, stuck); flinch-locks with mixed archetypes (the sweep's knockdown plus get-up, the Bruiser's smash, the boss's charge); the boss fight: can the autopilot win with revives, is it too easy (the builder measured a 38 s kill taking one charge); do waves repeat forever without leaks; the attack cadence (R1 measured 1 with a passive player after P1-engage: does a 6-enemy fight still feel dangerous, SPEC §7 'the danger is numbers'?). Record your own runs with the autopilot (held-back and full) and a passive player.

Lens L6, PERFORMANCE (Part B §B4 L6): R15 windowed (frame p95 <= 16.7 ms, spawn hitch <= 33 ms) with six mixed enemies fighting and ragdolling, the boss wave and its phase-2 call-in, a wave of Bruisers; the first knockdown's ragdoll build hitch; the voice budget (R14, windup_voices_stolen); node, object and resource counts flat over 20 waves (no leak from freed enemies, dropped pipes, EnemyHold); the test suite's time. Note the machine (Apple M1, 8 GB) and its load average for every number; the spec's target is an RTX 3060 on Windows, so judge headroom, not the target.
